items.title: 1 Consumer Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Question
items.summary: Retailers are adapting their business models as technology changes how people shop. Still, secular trends are working against them as e-commerce continues to take share from brick-and-mortar stores. This puts retail stocks in a tough spot, and over the past six months, the industry’s returns were flat while the S&P 500 gained 12.1%.
